node.statement: Direct nested-comparison threshold bridge. The constant used throughout this proof is chosen as e_s2 := min{1/2, e_nest, e_ncd, e_out, e_sim, e_ca/2}. Hence e_s2 <= e_nest by the defining order property of a finite minimum. The root hypothesis t <= e_s2 then gives t <= e_nest by transitivity. This derivation is universal and dimension-independent and uses no accuracy threshold from lem-extcb-corner-dimension-additivity.
